title: Crypto Decoded | Episode 3: The Rise of BNB (Binance Coin)
description:
Welcome back to Crypto Decoded, the cinematic series exploring the stories behind the world’s most influential cryptocurrencies.

In Episode 3, we uncover the rise of BNB (Binance Coin) and the story behind the world’s largest cryptocurrency exchange: Binance.

Founded by Changpeng Zhao (CZ) in 2017, Binance quickly grew from a small startup into one of the most powerful companies in the crypto industry.

At the center of this ecosystem was BNB, a token originally created to power trading discounts on the Binance platform.

But BNB evolved into something much bigger.
In this episode we explore:

• The founding of Binance
• The launch of BNB in 2017
• How Binance became the largest crypto exchange
• The creation of BNB Chain and Binance Smart Chain
• The growth of decentralized applications and DeFi
• How BNB became one of the largest cryptocurrencies in the world
• What the future of BNB could look like beyond 2026

BNB is more than just a token.
It powers an entire blockchain ecosystem used by millions of people around the world.

This is the next chapter in the Crypto Decoded series, uncovering the technologies and innovators shaping the future of digital finance.

asr.full_text: Act 1 The exchange that built its own economy from 2017 until 2018. What if one exchange didn't just dominate trading but built an entire financial ecosystem around its own token? In 2017, the crypto industry was chaotic. Mt. Gox was still a recent memory. Exchanges were slow, unreliable, and often insecure. Liquidity was fragmented. Then, in July 2017 Binance launched the new, founded by Changpengyao CZ, a developer with experience at blockchain.info and oka queen binance didn't position itself as ideological it positioned itself as efficient matching engine capable of 1.4 million orders per second aggressive listing strategy global first expansion within six months binance became the largest exchange in the world by trading volume but hidden inside this rise was a structural innovation launched through an ICO in 7-12-2017, raising roughly $15m. Total Supply 200million tokens, eligible donotherium as an ERC-20 asset , trading fee discounts, participation in token sales ecosystem perk, but embedded in the white paper was a key mechanism. Quarterly burns binance committed to using 20% of its profits to repurchase and destroy BNB until Supply reached 100 million. This created a reflexive economic loop more exchange volume more a profits more a bnb burnet reduced supply in 2018 the crypto market collapsed bitcoin fell over 80 percent Hundreds of eco projects disappeared. Yet Binance remained operational. BNB fell with the market. But it didn't vanish. Because unlike many tokens, BNB was tied to revenue. Utility wasn't hypothetical. It was active, the foundation was laid. BNB was not just speculation, it was structurally connected to one of the fastest growing companies in crypto, but binance wasn't satisfied with building an exchange it wanted sovereignty Act 2. What happened next? In the story of BNB, a huge shift. In April 2019, Binance launched its very own blockchain, Binance Chain. This was a massive step BNB officially moved off of Ethereum. But why make such a bold move? The simple answer is control. Ethereum was and still is a powerhouse. But it was getting crowded, — network congestion meant gas fees were all over the place and transaction speeds were the time Binance was fully distributed. With the first Binance transaction, something more extreme, as Binance's Bitcoin chain was so fast in the market that no Bitcoin community on the market could be affected by such a fast trade, so the Bitcoin chain started to shift, as the market stopped running. By this time, it was clear that these companies were very bad in the crypto industry, but their real game- came in september 2020 with a launch of binance smart chain orbear this was the moment everything accelerated unlike the first chain bsc was fully compatible with the Ethereum Virtual Machine . This meant developers could easily bring their apps over from Ethereum with almost no extra work. The timing couldn't have been better. The DeFi summer of 2020 was in full swing and Ethereum gas fees were skyrocketing. People were paying $50 even hundred dollars for a single transaction. BSC offered the same experience, but for just a few cents with transaction times of around three seconds. The result? A mass migration. A MASS! migration! suddenly? you had pancakeSwap, popping up as a serious alternative to Uniswap. Venus PRT enabled decentralized lending yield farming exploded on the new chain. before long. in 2021, BSEs daily transaction volume was regularly surpassing Ethereum's and this completely transformed BNB. It wasn't just a discount token anymore, it became the Gast. Power. The entire BSC ecosystem. An asset for staking to secure the network and collateral indeed BnB had evolved from a simple Exchange token into the computational fuel for a whole parallel blockchain economy. Its value was no longer just tied to the exchange. It was now the foundation of a rapidly growing infrastructure Hg-3 Hyper growth – speculation and scrutiny 2021 marked peak acceleration Crypto entered mainstream awareness Stimulus liquidity flooded markets Retail investors entered at scale BNB surged from under $40 in I'l 2021 to the second quarter of 2020, and, according to the Eurotax, the EUR 50% market share of BNB reached 5% of the total stock. BNB was the top high-end trader in the world in the second quarter of 2020, and had the record high market share of 1.3 billion dollars. Also, the market share of BNB was 1.4 billion of the full price. Vital Value Lock on BSC crossed tens of billions. Daily active user surpassed one million. At peak moments, BSC processed more transactions per day than OTHER, but growth exposed structural trader's growth. Valadar Asset size remained small around 21 active validars. Critics argued this created centralisation risk. Governance influence remained closely associated with BMB. Meanwhile regulators began targeting Binance operations in the UK, Japan, the US, and other jurisdictions. Compliance concerns mounted BMB's economic model was evolving too. In late 2021, Binance introduced the Auto Burn Mechanism. Instead of profit-based burns, supply reduction became algorithmically determined by BNB price number of blocks produced the goal. Transparent Predictability Reduced dependency on company revenue. By end of the year 2021, BNB had transitioned from corporate utility token to ecosystem asset with autonomous supply mechanics but scale had created a paradox. The larger BNB became, the more regulatory gravity it attracted. Dominance invites oversight. ECH, For Regulation, Restructuring and Decentralization2 to 202 2022 marked structural testing global regulators intensified scrutiny of investigations led to settlements and operational restructuring leadership transitions occurred the exchange adapted compliance frameworks meanwhile binance Leadership Transitions Occurred The Exchange Adapted Compliance Framework Meanwhile, Binance Smart Chain Rebranded To BMB chaîne Symbolically Distancing The Network From The Exchange Brand The Architecture Evolved BNB Beacon Chain Governance And Staking BNB Smart Chain EM execution layer-2 scaling initiatives VLADT or COUNT gradually expanded Cross-chain interoperability strengthened Security upgrades addressed bridge vulnerabilities after high-profile exploits in 2022 The ecosystem matured Less speculative yield farming after high-profile exploits in 2022. the ecosystem matured less speculative yield Farming more structured Infrastructure Development Enterprised exploration. BnB's Boone model. Continued reducing supply toward the 100 million Target at the same time staking participation deepened economic security increasingly relied on capital stake validator incentives on chain activity the narrative shifted from rapid expansion to durability could be nb evolved beyond its exchange origin? Or would it remain permanently tethered to Binance's corporate risk? T his became the defining question of the mid twenties, Act V. The strategic positioning 2030 & beyond. By 2030, the blockchain landscape is crowded. Ethereum focuses on settlement and roll-ups. Solana emphasizes performance, Layar II, Ecosystems, Fragment Liquidity. BNB's strategic advantage remains unique. Integrated liquidity pipeline, millions of Binance users represent potential on-chain A portfolio of 10 business units is created at a cost of 6,500 USD, with the portfolio value of 6,000 USD every year. In addition to its large number, more than 800 systems are built and developed in China and India. In addition to the scales globally bnb benefits structurally potential long-term vectors tokenized real-world assets emerging market payment rails web 3 gaming economies cross-border settlement systems however long-term sustainability depends on validator decentralization governance, regulatory adaptability, technical resilience. BNB success will not be measured solely by price appreciation. It will be measured by uptime, throughput, security, survival across regulatory cycles. If it persists through decades BNB could evolve into a retail dominant defi backbone, a bridge between Centralized liquidity and decentralized execution, a high throughput, settlement layer for mass adoption. it began as a fee discount it became a blockchain its future depends on structural independence block by block burn burn ecosystem by ecosystem ecosystem
